# Popcorn — Full Application & LLM Technical Specification

This document provides complete architectural and functional details for AI agents, LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity), and automated web crawlers examining the Popcorn Web Application.

---

## 1. System Identity & Mission
Popcorn is a cinematic movie & TV discovery Progressive Web App (PWA). It provides users with a fast, high-contrast, frosted-glass interface to explore trending box office films, stream official 4K/HD trailers via YouTube, inspect TMDB audience scores via circular SVG meters, and maintain an offline-resilient watchlist.

---

## 2. PWA & Offline Specification
- **Manifest**: Located at [`/manifest.json`](/manifest.json), specifies standalone display mode, custom icons ([`/favicon.svg`](/favicon.svg), [`/popcorn.svg`](/popcorn.svg)), theme color (`#050508`), and quick action shortcuts.
- **Service Worker**: Located at [`/sw.js`](/sw.js), implements Stale-While-Revalidate caching for static shell files, cache-first strategies for TMDB images (`image.tmdb.org`), and network-first strategies with offline fallback for metadata requests.
- **Installation**: Native browser `beforeinstallprompt` event binding on Android/Chrome/Edge, with visual iOS "Add to Home Screen" instructions for Safari on iOS.

---

## 3. SEO, Metadata & Discoverability
- **Standardized Schema**:
  - `WebApplication`: Application category, pricing ("Free"), operating systems.
  - `SiteNavigationElement`: Primary navigation targets.
  - `BreadcrumbList`: Structural hierarchy.
- **Meta Directives**:
  - `robots`: `index, follow` ([`robots.txt`](/robots.txt))
  - `sitemap`: [`sitemap.xml`](/sitemap.xml)
  - `OpenGraph`: Complete og:title, og:description, og:image, og:type, og:site_name.
  - `Twitter Card`: Large summary card format.
- **Crawler Permissiveness**: Full crawling permitted for AI agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Applebot, Google-Extended).

---

## 4. UI Architecture & Navigation Endpoints
- [Home Feed](/?tab=home): Dynamic billboard hero banner, top 10 leaderboards, trending blockbusters, and popular TV series.
- [Discover Catalog](/?tab=browse): Granular media filtering across feature films and TV shows by genre, release year, sort order, and TMDB user score.
- [Instant Search](/?tab=search): Real-time debounced search across titles, actors, genres, and directors with instant query suggestions.
- [User Library](/?tab=library): User's offline-resilient watchlist, favorites collection, and custom playback preferences.
- **RatingRing**: Scalable SVG ring rendering percentage calculations based on TMDB `vote_average` (0–10 scale mapped to 0–100%).
- **PopcornLogo**: Cinema-themed logo with glowing amber-to-rose gradient badge and animated live status dot.
- **FeaturedHero**: Dynamic widescreen billboard displaying trending media with trailer playback trigger.
- **TopTenRow**: Numbered ranking row displaying the top 10 ranked movies or shows.
- **DetailModal**: Full modal dialog featuring trailer iframe, synopsis, genres, runtime, release date, and TMDB score.
- **InstallBanner**: Native PWA install card that triggers device installation.

---

## 5. Media Data Schema (TypeScript)
```typescript
export interface Movie {
  id: number;
  title?: string;
  name?: string; // For TV series
  overview: string;
  poster_path: string | null;
  backdrop_path: string | null;
  vote_average: number; // 0.0 - 10.0 TMDB Rating
  vote_count?: number;
  release_date?: string;
  first_air_date?: string; // For TV series
  genre_ids?: number[];
  genres?: { id: number; name: string }[];
  media_type?: 'movie' | 'tv';
  runtime?: number;
  number_of_seasons?: number;
  trailer_key?: string; // YouTube video ID
}
```
